name: SheTech Internship (Thanksgiving Point)
what_you_do: High school girls do real STEM projects. Topics include insects, exhibit design, wetland repair, growing plants in water, coding lessons and school programs.
who_can_apply: High school girls. The page does not list grades. The program is accredited through Alpine School District for the fall and spring semesters only.
pay_detail: Pay is not stated. Interns in some roles get a Thanksgiving Point Team Member Membership.
duration: 40 hours per semester for the district credit; some roles need more
deadline_text: Dates and deadlines are not posted on the page.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply Now button on the page. Questions: Stacie Wilding, swilding@thanksgivingpoint.org, 801-768-7426.
notes: The page says the credit is for fall and spring semesters only.
